component_definitions.collector_other_s: Collector minus compiled validator, both original AIG passes/recipe, and runtime JSON output. Includes collector artifact hashing/parsing, CNF reconstruction, witness/sample bookkeeping and instrumentation overhead.
component_definitions.compiled_validator_s: Full: exact CNF serialization hash plus full compiled evaluation. Cone: immutable capture (including exact CNF serialization hash) plus sparse evaluation (including cold plan construction).
component_definitions.output_s: Top-level admission/reference output plus runtime collector provenance/witness/report JSON output. Nested runtime output is already inside collector.
component_definitions.reference_validation_s: Test-only whole-sample original combinational reference reevaluation and witness/receipt comparison, included in primary wall.
component_definitions.startup_exit_unassigned_s: Primary direct-child wall minus all disjoint top phases. Includes Python pre-main startup, final summary emission, interpreter exit, controller launch/wait overhead and intervals between phases.
component_definitions.upstream_binding_s: The two unchanged model-bearing read_model_batch/bound_model layers; all emitted rows and matching candidate receipts. No proof solver bookkeeping, new emission or SAT.

limitations: Saved fixed-record pipeline only, not end-to-end transform speed or area gain.
Two matched order-reversed sweeps, not a statistical confidence claim.
OS file cache was not flushed; first-trial cache/startup effects are retained.
Nested timers overlap their parents; do not sum them with collector/upstream/top-level phase times.
This host/runtime was restarted before the experiment; do not compare these times directly with the earlier negative pilot.
